ns2:course.label: Dec-Making & Cntrl Appl in Mfg
ns2:course.description: Integrates production planning, production scheduling, and process supervision and control into a manufacturing hierarchy. Demonstrates interfaces with other manufacturing functions. Focuses on the integration of the functions as well as the integration of decision-making and control considerations. Graduate credit is not given to students in the College of Engineering, except by special permission of the student's department. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor. A course in probability is desirable.
